/* IT log-collection script: archives event text through ADODB. */
var conn = WSH.CreateObject("ADODB.Connection");
conn.Open("Provider=SQLOLEDB;Server=logdb;");
var stream = WSH.CreateObject("ADODB.Stream");
stream.Type = 2;
stream.Charset = "us-ascii";
stream.Open();
stream.WriteText(GetLogText());
stream.SaveToFile("C:\\logs\\archive.txt", 2);
